title: Bogus.
text: Just because items may COST a certain amount doesn't mean they're WORTH that amount.  The value that GQ touts these boxes at hardly reflects what you would actually pay for the contents.  In fact, a large part of the contents are tiny samples of high-cost skin creams and such, amounting to little more than advertising that I paid to get.  Feeling kind of stupid now.  Cancelled.
label: negative
